name: table
description: Promote a range to an Excel Table so later skills can use headers and keys

tools.name: ensure_table
tools.description: Turn a range into an Excel Table (first row = headers). If the range is already a table, return it. Required before reconcile_tables, reshape_table, and calculate_table. Returns the actual table name (Chinese names are prefixed, e.g. T_系统订单表); always use that name in later calls.

range.description: Optional A1 range including header row, e.g. A1:D50. If omitted, uses the sheet's used range. Do not include the sheet name.

tableName.description: Optional table name. Chinese names are stored as T_系统订单表; always use the returned name.
